changelog:
DECIPHER CORP. | VERSION 1.0.0
Codename: First Contact

Welcome to Decipher Corp., Agent.

• Initial release of the Decipher Corp. system.
• Employee onboarding with username registration and unique DC-ID generation.
• Personalized employee settings, including custom symbols for confirmations, negative responses, and notifications.
• Local employee database for storing identity details, status, preferences, and account information.
• Decipher Corp. Intranet with access to employee ID, contract details, debriefing news, Decipher Mail, and Decider Invest.
• Employee ID card displaying personal identification and account details.
• Intelligence operations: Receive a Transmission, Decrypt It, Encrypt It, and Archive.
• Settings menu and persistent system state.
• Corporate boot sequence with startup audio and welcome messages.
